## Keep one API authority

The generated function reference is maintained upstream. Use it for exact arguments, defaults, return values, and package-level examples:

<https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/>

The current upstream reference includes the `scop` function index, articles, and versioned package navigation. SCOP Learn adds a teaching layer around those functions; it does not copy or override generated API pages.

## Useful starting points

- [RunStandardWorkflow](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/RunStandardWorkflow.html)
- [RunCellQC](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/RunCellQC.html)
- [RunDimsEstimate](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/RunDimsEstimate.html)
- [RunSpatialNetwork](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/RunSpatialNetwork.html)
- [RunSpatialVariableFeatures](https://mengxu98.github.io/scop/reference/RunSpatialVariableFeatures.html)

If a linked page changes or disappears, the site link check should fail and the lesson should be reviewed before release.
